The chart app has three call sites, all in two files. The framework definition is in openmrs-esm-core, and I only saw its line from search output, so its end line is unverified.

**Patient chart call sites (verified in the local checkout):**
- `useOrderableConceptSWR` calls `reportError(error)` from a `useEffect` when the SWR fetch fails (lines 34-38). Its error state is also returned to callers.
- `useOrderableConceptSets` calls `reportError(error)` from a second `useEffect` on the same failure path (lines 71-75). This is the hook the orders UI consumes.
- `useFavoritesActions` → `persistFavorites` calls `reportError(error)` in its `catch` block, right before showing an error snackbar (lines 55-63). Both the pin and unpin flows go through it.

**Framework definition (openmrs-esm-core):** `reportError` is exported from `packages/framework/esm-error-handling/src/index.ts:56`. Its body was not read.

**Outside the chart app, for context:** `openmrs-esm-patient-management` (registration app) also calls `reportError` in `field.component.tsx` and `coded-person-attribute-field.component.tsx`. The form engine has its own unrelated `reportError` in `src/utils/error-utils.ts`, so it is not affected by a change to the framework function.
